title: Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards: government response to report
description: The government's response to the Committee's 2020 report Artificial Intelligence and Public Standards
summary: The government is responding to a 2020 report on artificial intelligence and public standards with a new policy. This policy aims to regulate and promote responsible use of AI in public services.

title: ​​Ofqual’s approach to regulating the use of artificial intelligence in the qualifications sector​
description: Published in response to a request from the Secretary of State for Education, the Secretary of State for Science, Innovation and Technology, and the Secretary of State for Business and Trade.
summary: Ofqual's policy document outlines its approach to regulating artificial intelligence in qualifications. It was published in response to a request from the UK government to address AI's use in the qualifications sector.

title: Report and impact assessment on Copyright and Artificial Intelligence
description: A report and impact assessment on the use of copyright works in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) systems.
summary: This report examines how copyright law affects the use of original works in developing artificial intelligence systems. It assesses the potential impact of copyright on the creation and utilization of AI technology.

title: Government response to the House of Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence
description: Government response to the Lords Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence report ‘AI in the UK: No Room for Complacency’.
summary: The UK government has responded to a report highlighting concerns about the impact of artificial intelligence in the country. The response aims to address these concerns and take steps to ensure the responsible development and deployment of AI.

title: AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference
description: Terms of Reference and FAQs for the Committee's review into artificial intelligence and public standards.
summary: The 'AI and Public Standards – Terms of Reference' outlines the terms and FAQs for a committee reviewing how artificial intelligence fits into public standards. The review's goal is likely to establish guidelines and frameworks for AI technology in the public sector.

title: CSPL submission to Science and Technology Committee inquiry on Governance of AI
description: CSPL has submitted written evidence to the Science and Technology Committee's inquiry on Governance of Artificial Intelligence.
summary: The CSPL has submitted written evidence to an inquiry on AI governance, likely outlining their views on how AI should be controlled and regulated. The submission aims to inform the Science and Technology Committee's understanding of AI governance.

title: Impact of AI on the regulation of medical products
description: Implementing the Artificial Intelligence (AI) White Paper principles.
summary: This document aims to understand how artificial intelligence affects the regulation of medical products. It plans to implement principles outlined in the AI White Paper to ensure effective regulation.

title: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
description: Our vision is that, in terms of AI, we will be the world’s most effective, efficient, trusted and influential Defence organisation for our size.
summary: The UK Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy aims to make the Defence organisation the most effective and influential in the world for its size when it comes to artificial intelligence. It focuses on achieving excellence in AI while being efficient and trusted.

title: Transport artificial intelligence action plan
description: Sets out how DfT will work with the transport sector to exploit the opportunities from AI while managing potential risks.
summary: This document outlines a plan for the Department for Transport (DfT) to use artificial intelligence (AI) in the transport sector, while also addressing potential risks associated with its use. The goal of the plan is to maximize the benefits of AI in transportation while ensuring its safe and effective implementation.

title: Copyright and artificial intelligence: progress report
description: A progress report on the use of copyright works in the development of AI systems, under Section 137 of the Data (Use and Access) Act.
summary: This report discusses how copyrighted materials are used in the development of artificial intelligence systems. It is an assessment of progress made under specific guidelines set by the Data (Use and Access) Act.
